content: This release only ensures correct PyPI licensing metadata. [#1386](https://github.com/python-attrs/attrs/issues/1386)

github.content:
### GitHub Issue #1386 Pypi does not recognize license
Unless there is a delay, it seems that the LICENSE metadata is not available in Pypi for release 24.3.0, see https://pypi.org/project/attrs/24.3.0/

Note that this information was available in 24.2.0, see https://pypi.org/project/attrs/24.2.0/

I suspect the changes from https://github.com/python-attrs/attrs/pull/1377 are the cause for this problem.
